text: You captchalogue the BOX through your HASH MAP FETCH MODUS.
Your modus's current HASH FUNCTION resolves the index by valuing each consonant at 2, and each vowel at 1. The total is divided by your number of cards, and the remainder is the index.
The BOX is captchalogued in card 5.
alt: You captchalogue the box. An array of 10 numbered cards appear on the side of the screen, and a hash function menu appears, converting the name 'BOX' into an addition equation. The box is stored in card 5.
command: Dave: Examine jar of unknown yellow substance in the closet.
